task.title: Add discovery session button to Tasks view
task.description: Add a comment-discussion icon button next to the existing + button in the KANBAN TASKS header to launch kanban-discover sessions directly from the sidebar.
task.problem: The current + button only creates tasks, but users may want to start a discovery session instead. There is no way to access kanban-discover from the Tasks view, making the discovery workflow less discoverable.
task.value: Users can choose between creating a task directly or exploring questions first, right from the sidebar. This makes the discovery workflow more accessible and discoverable without requiring knowledge of slash commands.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the KANBAN TASKS view is visible in the sidebar When the user looks at the view header Then they see a comment-discussion icon button next to the existing + button
Given the user hovers over the discovery button When the tooltip appears Then it shows a rich markdown tooltip: "**Discovery Session**\nExplore questions and analyze the codebase through Socratic Q&A before creating tasks."
Given the user hovers over the create task button When the tooltip appears Then it shows a rich markdown tooltip: "**Create Task**\nCreate a new task through conversational Q&A. Captures problem, value, and acceptance criteria."
Given the user clicks the discovery button When the action executes Then a terminal opens and runs the /kanban-discover command
Given VSCode uses a light or dark theme When the discovery button is displayed Then the icon uses ThemeIcon and adapts to the current theme
